import bpy, os

out = r'C:\mcp-blender\blender_bridge\previews\latest_viewport.png'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out), exist_ok=True)

# Ensure the current Lacerda model is visible and framed before capture.
coll = bpy.data.collections.get('Lacerda_Do_Zero')
if coll:
    coll.hide_viewport = False
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
    for o in coll.objects:
        if not o.hide_viewport:
            try:
                o.hide_set(False)
                o.select_set(True)
            except Exception:
                pass

area_found = None
region_found = None
window_found = None
for window in bpy.context.window_manager.windows:
    for area in window.screen.areas:
        if area.type == 'VIEW_3D':
            region = next((r for r in area.regions if r.type == 'WINDOW'), None)
            if region:
                window_found, area_found, region_found = window, area, region
                break
    if area_found:
        break

if not area_found:
    raise RuntimeError('Nenhuma VIEW_3D encontrada')

with bpy.context.temp_override(window=window_found, screen=window_found.screen, area=area_found, region=region_found):
    if coll and coll.objects:
        bpy.ops.view3d.view_selected(use_all_regions=False)

scene = bpy.context.scene
old_path = scene.render.filepath
old_x = scene.render.resolution_x
old_y = scene.render.resolution_y
old_pct = scene.render.resolution_percentage
old_fmt = scene.render.image_settings.file_format
try:
    scene.render.filepath = out
    scene.render.resolution_x = 640
    scene.render.resolution_y = 480
    scene.render.resolution_percentage = 100
    scene.render.image_settings.file_format = 'PNG'
    with bpy.context.temp_override(window=window_found, screen=window_found.screen, area=area_found, region=region_found):
        bpy.ops.render.opengl(write_still=True, view_context=True)
finally:
    scene.render.filepath = old_path
    scene.render.resolution_x = old_x
    scene.render.resolution_y = old_y
    scene.render.resolution_percentage = old_pct
    scene.render.image_settings.file_format = old_fmt

size = os.path.getsize(out) if os.path.exists(out) else -1
print(f'VISUAL_SNAPSHOT={out}; SIZE={size}; SCENE={scene.name}; FILE={bpy.data.filepath}')
